Quillmark sent me another of their panel surveys and I keep forgetting it. Please can you do it for me at {URL}? My member number is QP-308415. I'm in the 35 to 44 age group, I live in the Central Plains region, and there are 4 of us in the household.
We mostly shop at a discount grocer and spend about 145 pounds a week. In the past year I've used Larder Run and Parcelpear for delivery, about a few times a month.
How much things matter to me: low prices very, fresh produce extremely, fast delivery slightly, less packaging somewhat.
I'd recommend my main shop 7 out of 10. For the question about my last grocery shop, say: Delivery arrived on time but the bananas were badly bruised and two items were swapped without asking. Yes to follow-up surveys.
They give you a confirmation code at the end, send me that.
